column1: # Per task: UTC time its agent phase became offline (model-API allowlist, as CWE-bench). Runs that
# started earlier had open internet; see build/internet_use.py. Read by build/audit_results.py.

# disallowed web tools, with its first run start (UTC). Before this, these tasks were treated as open-internet and
